title: Ekhaya nomndeni
description: Ten short, simple stories about home, family and everyday moments in KwaZulu-Natal.

lessons.title: Igama lami
lessons.summary: Themba is a child who lives in a big house; Thandi, a smaller child, lives in a small one, and both are happy there.
lessons.text:
Igama lami nguThemba. Mina ngiyingane. Ngihlala endlini enkulu kakhulu.

UThandi naye uyingane. Yena mncane kakhulu kunami. Igama lakhe nguThandi. UThandi uhlala endlini encane.

UThandi uthi: "Themba, indlu yakho inkulu na?"

Ngithi: "Kunjalo, indlu yami inkulu kakhulu. Ngihlala lapho njalo. Indlu yakho yona incane na?"

"Kunjalo, indlu yami incane," kusho uThandi. "Kodwa mina ngimncane futhi. Ingane encane ihlala kahle endlini encane."

Ngithi: "Nami ngiyingane, futhi ngihlala kahle endlini enkulu."

Imibuzo:
Igama lengane enkulu lithini?
Igama layo nguThemba.
UThandi uhlala endlini enkulu na?
Cha, uThandi uhlala endlini encane.
UThemba usho ukuthi indlu yakhe inkulu na?
Kunjalo, usho ukuthi inkulu kakhulu.

lessons.title: Umsebenzi kaNomsa
lessons.summary: Nomsa works long days in Durban and earns a lot of money, but she needs time; she takes a smaller job and gets her time back.
lessons.text:
UNomsa usebenza eThekwini. Umsebenzi wakhe mkhulu kakhulu. Usebenza usuku lonke, nsuku zonke.

UNomsa uthola imali eningi ngoba usebenza kakhulu. Kodwa manje uNomsa uthi: "Ngifuna isikhathi."

"Ngiyayidinga imali," kusho uNomsa. "Kumele ngisebenze ngoba ngidinga imali. Kodwa ngidinga isikhathi futhi. Manje isikhathi sami sincane kakhulu."

Ngolunye usuku uNomsa uthola omunye umsebenzi. Lo msebenzi mncane. Imali yawo incane, kodwa uNomsa uthola isikhathi esiningi. Akudingeki asebenze usuku lonke.

Manje uNomsa uthi: "Ngithola imali encane, kodwa ngithola isikhathi. Yilokhu engikufunayo. Akumele umuntu asebenze njalo."

Imibuzo:
UNomsa usebenza eThekwini na?
Kunjalo, usebenza eThekwini.
UNomsa uthola imali eningi ngoba usebenza kakhulu na?
Kunjalo, uthola imali eningi ngoba usebenza kakhulu.
UNomsa udingani manje?
Udinga isikhathi.

lessons.title: Indlela eya eThekwini
lessons.summary: Thabo leaves his small village for Durban, follows the big road, looks at the places on the way and arrives in the city.
lessons.text:
UThabo uhlala endaweni encane. Manje uya eThekwini. Usuka endaweni yakhe, uhamba ngendlela enkulu.

UThabo ulandela indlela. Akahambi ngaphandle kwendlela, ngoba ngaphandle kwendlela kunezindawo angazazi. Ubheka izindawo eziningi. Ubheka abantu abahamba endleleni futhi.

Abantu abaningi beza eThekwini. Abanye basuka ezindaweni ezinkulu, abanye basuka ezindaweni ezincane.

UThabo ufika eThekwini. Uhamba phakathi kwezindlu ezinkulu. Ubheka phakathi kwendawo, ubona abantu abaningi kakhulu. Abanye bafika njengaye, abanye beza kamuva.

"Ngizohamba futhi ngiye endaweni yami," uthi, "kodwa manje ngifuna ukubheka le ndawo."

Imibuzo:
UThabo usuka endaweni enkulu na?
Cha, usuka endaweni encane.
UThabo uhamba ngaphandle kwendlela na?
Cha, ulandela indlela.
UThabo ufika eThekwini na?
Kunjalo, ufika eThekwini.

lessons.title: Abantu bomhlaba
lessons.summary: A teacher, Lungelo, tells the children that people live in many countries of the world, and that the world is everyone's.
lessons.text:
ULungelo uthi ezinganeni: "Emhlabeni kunabantu abaningi kakhulu. Abantu bahlala emazweni amaningi."

"Thina sihlala ezweni lethu. Abanye bahlala emazweni amanye. Bona bahlala ezweni labo, kodwa nabo bangabantu njengathi."

Ingane encane ithi: "Bonke abantu bahlala emhlabeni munye na?"

ULungelo uthi: "Kunjalo. Thina, nabo, nawe. Wena uhlala emhlabeni lo, futhi nami ngihlala kuwo."

Ingane ithi: "Abantu abaningi bathi uNkulunkulu wenza umhlaba."

"Kunjalo," kusho uLungelo. "Abantu abaningi bathi uNkulunkulu wenza umhlaba wonke. Umhlaba ungowethu sonke. Thina sonke singabantu bomhlaba."

Imibuzo:
Abantu bahlala ezweni elinye nje na?
Cha, bahlala emazweni amaningi.
Abantu abaningi bathini ngoNkulunkulu?
Bathi uNkulunkulu wenza umhlaba.
Umhlaba ungowethu sonke na?
Kunjalo, umhlaba ungowethu sonke.

lessons.title: Iqembu lomphakathi
lessons.summary: A community group talks about a rule for the children's road and makes a plan so that everyone knows it.
lessons.text:
Emphakathini wethu kuneqembu labantu abaningi. Iqembu likhuluma njalo ngezinto zomphakathi.

Manje iqembu likhuluma ngomthetho. Umthetho uthi izingane kumele zisebenzise indlela encane. Akumele zisebenzise indlela enkulu.

UNandi uthi: "Ngiyazi ukuthi umthetho muhle. Kodwa umphakathi udinga uhlelo futhi."

"Uhlelo luthini?" kusho uThabo.

UNandi uthi: "Uhlelo luthi iqembu lizokhuluma nabantu bomphakathi njalo, ukuze bonke bazi umthetho. Ngifuna ukuthi zonke izingane zisebenzise indlela encane."

Abantu bomphakathi bayakhuluma futhi. Bathi uhlelo luhle. Iqembu lisebenzisa uhlelo. Manje umphakathi wazi umthetho, futhi izingane zisebenzisa indlela encane njalo.

Imibuzo:
Iqembu likhuluma ngomthetho na?
Kunjalo, likhuluma ngomthetho.
UNandi uthi umphakathi udingani?
Uthi umphakathi udinga uhlelo.
Izingane zisebenzisa indlela enkulu na?
Cha, zisebenzisa indlela encane.

lessons.title: Izinto ezindala
lessons.summary: Lindiwe looks through her old things, keeps the beautiful ones and gives two of them to Themba.
lessons.text:
ULindiwe unezinto eziningi ezindala. Uzigcina endlini yakhe.

Ngolunye usuku uLindiwe uthatha izinto zakhe ezindala. Uzibeka phansi, uzibheka zonke. Into yokuqala inhle kakhulu.

ULindiwe uthi: "Lokhu kuhle kakhulu. Ngizokugcina."

Uthatha ezinye izinto ezimbili ezinhle. Uzifaka phakathi kwezandla zakhe. Uthi: "Lezi zinto ezimbili ngizozinika uThemba."

"Themba, ngikunika lokhu," kusho uLindiwe. "Izinto zami zindala, kodwa zinhle."

UThemba uthatha izinto ezimbili. Uzifaka endlini yakhe. Uthi: "Zinhle kakhulu! Ngizozigcina kahle."

ULindiwe ubeka ezinye izinto endlini futhi. Uyazi ukuthi into endala nayo ingaba yinhle kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
ULindiwe unezinto ezindala na?
Kunjalo, unezinto eziningi ezindala.
ULindiwe unika uThemba izinto ezimbili na?
Kunjalo, umnika izinto ezimbili.
UThemba uzokwenzani ngezinto?
Uzozigcina kahle.

lessons.title: Unyaka wonke
lessons.summary: Sibusiso works hard all year to save money; at the end he can get a small house of his own.
lessons.text:
USibusiso ufuna ukwenza izinto eziningi kulo nyaka. Uyazi ukuthi kufanele asebenze kakhulu.

"Uma ngisebenza kakhulu, ngingaba nemali," usho. "Ngifuna imali ukuze ngithole indlu yami."

USibusiso akazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kulo nyaka. Kodwa uthi: "Noma kungenzeka izinto ezimbi, kufanele ngenze umsebenzi wami kahle."

Unyaka wonke uSibusiso uyasebenza. Uthola imali kanye ngenyanga, futhi uyigcina. Noma efuna izinto eziningi, uthi: "Imali le ngeyendlu."

Ngemuva konyaka uSibusiso unemali eningi. Uthola indlu encane. "Kwenzeke into enhle kakhulu," usho. "Uma umuntu esebenza kanye nabanye, kungenzeka izinto ezinhle. Lo nyaka ube muhle."

Imibuzo:
USibusiso ufuna ukwenzani kulo nyaka?
Ufuna ukwenza izinto eziningi.
USibusiso ufuna imali ukuze athole indlu na?
Kunjalo, ufuna imali ukuze athole indlu.
Ngemuva konyaka uSibusiso uthola indlu na?
Kunjalo, uthola indlu encane.

lessons.title: Amandla kaMpho
lessons.summary: An old man appears on the road with a heavy thing; young Mpho helps him carry it into the house and the man is grateful.
lessons.text:
UMpho uyingane encane, kepha unamandla amaningi.

Ngolunye usuku kuvela umuntu omdala endleleni. Ufuna ukungena endlini yakhe. Uthatha into enkulu, kepha akanawo amandla. Uyibeka phansi.

UMpho uthi: "Ake ngikusize. Ake ngithathe lokhu."

Umuntu omdala uthi: "Wena uyingane encane. Unawo amandla?"

UMpho uthatha into, uhamba kahle. Bangena endlini yomuntu omdala. UMpho uyibeka phansi kahle.

"Kanti unamandla amaningi! Kanti wena mkhulu!" kusho umuntu omdala. "Ungisizile kakhulu. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ngizokusiza nami."

Kamuva uMpho uthi kuThandi: "Ngisize umuntu omdala. Ke, ngiyazi manje ukuthi ingane encane ingaba namandla."

Imibuzo:
Kuvela umuntu omdala endleleni na?
Kunjalo, kuvela umuntu omdala.
UMpho usiza umuntu omdala na?
Kunjalo, uyamsiza.
UMpho nomuntu omdala bangena endlini na?
Kunjalo, bangena endlini yomuntu omdala.

lessons.title: Imali kaKhanyisile
lessons.summary: Khanyisile cannot find her money anywhere in the house; it turns out Themba found it on the road and kept it for her.
lessons.text:
UKhanyisile ufuna imali yakhe. Uthi: "Imali yami ayikho! Ngiyayidinga yona."

Ubheka endlini. Imali ayikho lapho. Ubheka ngaphandle. Nalapho ayikho. Ubheka phakathi kwezinto zakhe. Izinto zakhe zikhona, kodwa zona azinayo imali. Ubheka nasemsebenzini wakhe, kodwa nawo awunayo.

Kanti uThemba unayo. UThemba uthi: "Khanyisile, imali yakho ikhona. Nginayo yona. Ngiyithole endleleni, ngayigcina."

UKhanyisile uthi: "Lokho kuhle kakhulu! Umsebenzi wakho muhle. Wona ungisize kakhulu. Ngifuna ukuthi wazi lokho nje."

UThemba uthi: "Ngithole enye into futhi: igama lakho. Lona likhona phakathi kwezinto. Ngikunika lona." UThemba unika uKhanyisile enye into encane.

UKhanyisile uthatha zonke izinto zakhe. Uthi: "Zona zonke zikhona manje. Kuhle nje."

Imibuzo:
Imali kaKhanyisile ikhona endlini na?
Cha, ayikho lapho.
UThemba unayo imali na?
Kunjalo, unayo yona.
UThemba uthola enye into futhi na?
Kunjalo, uthola enye into encane.

lessons.title: Lezi zingane ziyafana
lessons.summary: On their first day at work, the twins Nandi and Lindiwe confuse everyone because they look exactly alike.
lessons.text:
UNandi noLindiwe bayafana kakhulu. Njengoba befana, abantu abaningi abazi ukuthi lo nguNandi noma uLindiwe.

Lesi yisikhathi sabo sokuqala emsebenzini. Le ndawo yomsebenzi inkulu. Baqala umsebenzi kanye ngosuku lokuqala.

Umuntu othile uthi: "Nina nifana kakhulu! Lo nguNandi na? Lo omunye nguLindiwe na?"

UNandi uthi: "Cha, mina nginguNandi. Lo nguLindiwe."

Ekuqaleni abantu abazi. Kodwa njengoba isikhathi sihamba, bayabona ukuthi abafani nje. UNandi ukhuluma kakhulu, uLindiwe ukhuluma kancane. Kule ndawo bonke bayabazi manje.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi umuntu othile uthi: "Manje ngiyazi! Nina anifani. Lesi sikhathi sokuqala besingesihle, kodwa manje ngiyanazi."

Imibuzo:
UNandi noLindiwe bayafana na?
Kunjalo, bayafana kakhulu.
Baqala umsebenzi ngosuku lokuqala na?
Kunjalo, baqala ngosuku lokuqala.
UNandi ukhuluma kakhulu na?
Kunjalo, uNandi ukhuluma kakhulu.
